demo.title: blockchain-iq-x402.sh
demo.code:
# Blockchain IQ: analyst-verified crypto research over x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). No signup, no API key.
# Free catalog and indexes
curl -s "https://www.blockchainiq.co/api/x402/v1"           # every resource and price
curl -s "https://www.blockchainiq.co/api/x402/v1/research"  # coin research index (slugs)

# Paid call: you get HTTP 402 with payment terms; pay with an x402 client and retry
curl -s "https://www.blockchainiq.co/api/x402/v1/research/ondo"   # one coin's research brief, $0.05
curl -s "https://www.blockchainiq.co/api/x402/v1/brief"           # market brief, $0.01

# MCP: https://www.blockchainiq.co/api/mcp

setup: No signup or API key. You need an x402-capable agent or wallet with USDC on Base (or Solana).
Start with the free catalog: `GET https://www.blockchainiq.co/api/x402/v1`.
On HTTP 402, check the payee and price against the skill's catalog, confirm with the user, pay and retry to receive JSON.
Optional: connect the MCP server at https://www.blockchainiq.co/api/mcp
